message: Photoshop fixes: shapes and elements on any document resolution, icons as editable vector shapes, guides and mockups placed pixel for pixel.

history.title: Photoshop fixes: shapes on any resolution, vector icons, guides & mockups

changes.text: Photoshop: shapes from the Create tab and the Elements tab are the right size and in the right place on 300 ppi (and any non-72 ppi) documents
Photoshop: safe-zone guides, device mockups and PNG icons are placed pixel for pixel on any document resolution
Photoshop: Icons tab > Shape makes real editable vector shape layers (fill and outline icons, grouped) - if Photoshop refuses, the PNG is added instead
Photoshop: New document with black background is really black; Social sizes keeps your background colour; Layers to PNG exports hidden layers too
Photoshop: Safe Guide Remove also finds guides inside groups; Editor > Media button reads 'Add to document'

history.title: Photoshop Color Studio fix, AI Mode + Elements in Photoshop, comment automation

changes.text: Photoshop: Color Studio now works on every layer type - text, shape, pixel, smart object, fill layers, the locked Background and locked layers (it unlocks what it must, turns layer effects on, and the panel reloads its Photoshop script after an update, so no 'Unknown color tool')
Photoshop: AI Mode tab with Direct Chat, BG Remove, AI Enhancer and Create Image - chat edits run as Photoshop scripts on your document (one Undo), generated images go in as layers

Photoshop: Elements tab - 349 premade editable elements in 9 groups (Sale & Badges, Buttons, Arrows, Icons, Social, Labels, Frames, Posters, Backgrounds), each in several colour styles; built as a group of vector shape layers, live text and layer styles

Elements > Automation: 14 comment automation animations - reel and YouTube comment -> auto reply -> DM in a phone mockup, comment flood with auto replies, comment keyword -> DM, DM inbox auto replies (dark, light, purple, green)
Photoshop: API Keys section is visible in Settings so AI Mode keys can be added

history.title: Photoshop round trip, Color Studio, Automation elements, Cursor effects

changes.text: After Effects: one Photoshop button in the Quick tab (next to Snapshot, Import, Export) - the comp at the playhead goes to Photoshop as editable layers: text = editable text, solids and simple shapes = editable shape layers, images = Smart Objects, drop shadow / glow / stroke / colour overlay = editable layer styles
Photoshop: Send to After Effects button (Layers tab) - the document comes into After Effects as an editable comp
Photoshop: Color Studio - solid or gradient Color Overlay, gradient / solid Stroke, fill layers, 18 colours, 16 gradients, blend mode, opacity, angle, scale, reverse - on every selected layer
Photoshop: Image Download - paste links from Google Images, Instagram, Pinterest, X, Reddit, Unsplash, Pexels or any website; images only, straight into Photoshop
Elements: new Automation tab - 49 animations (workflow nodes, IF branches, checklists, CI/CD, gears, toasts, email, schedule, API, data sync, switch, counters, bots, conveyor)

Theme: Cursor effects - 14 animations that follow the mouse in the panel (glow, ring, sparkles, comet, ribbon, bubbles, embers, snow, confetti, pixels, hearts, ripples, orbit, electric) with On / Off, amount, size and colour
Guides: "My profile" - Reels, TikTok, Shorts, Stories, YouTube and Pinterest guides show the Motionsfly profile (avatar, name, verified badge, likes, comments, caption, audio)
Captions upgraded to CaptionKit 2.3: every language gets a font that has its letters, right-to-left languages, better offline Whisper on Mac, shared API key vault
Comp Saver / Library (AE + Premiere): the category row no longer lists every sub-folder - only folders with saved items, the rest in a Folders menu
Photoshop: the Download section is images only (no video / audio)

history.title: Photoshop import, paste & export folder, Text Plate

changes.text: Photoshop: Import button - images, PSD, AI / PDF / SVG, RAW and video come in as layers (or Open as new documents)
Photoshop: Paste Image - copy any image in the browser (right-click > Copy image) or a screenshot and paste it straight into Photoshop; Paste New makes a document from the clipboard
Photoshop: choose your own export folder (Save Copy, To Folder, Layers PNG, Social sizes)
Quick Tools > Layer: Text Plate replaces Text Box - box, pill, outline, underline or marker that follows the text, with grow-in animation
After Effects: To Photoshop / From Photoshop buttons work (they showed "Tool not loaded")
Photoshop: Send to AE / Get from AE really send the document now
Photoshop: new direct connection - no more "MK_NOT_LOADED"; if scripts can't load, a banner shows the reason
Photoshop: Select Subject, Remove BG and Stamp work when a hidden layer, group or text layer is selected; clear message instead of "General Photoshop error"
Removed the 2.57 tools Click Pointer, Dot Burst, Dot Wipe and Smart Reveal
Photoshop CC 2017 (18.0) and newer can open the panel

history.title: Fix update for 2.57

changes.text: 2.57.0 build could stop MotionKit from working in After Effects, Premiere Pro and Photoshop - 2.57.1 uses the normal code again
FX Search window: no more lock / "files were changed" message after updating

history.title: Click Pointer, Dot Burst, Dot Wipe, Smart Reveal

changes.text: Quick Tools > Tools: Click Pointer - a mouse pointer travels to the selected layers and clicks them (6 styles, press, ripple, 3D lift, trail, clicked layer reacts)
Quick Tools > Tools: Dot Burst - halftone dot shockwave from a layer with glow (1-5 waves, dots or pixels)
Quick Tools > Tools: Dot Wipe - transition through growing dots or pixels from 7 directions
Quick Tools > Tools: Smart Reveal - 10 reveal looks (Soft Wipe, Blur In, Flicker, Spiral, Glitch, Pixelate, Blinds, Vortex, Zoom In, Light Burn) on one slider
Text Box rebuilt: a box layer under the text that follows the text, with padding, corner, colour and opacity
Photoshop opens its own MotionKit page - no After Effects / Premiere code runs in Photoshop
Captions: "Host script error" fixed; offline Whisper engine built in on Mac (no Homebrew)
Captions Gemini key can no longer be overwritten by AI Mode

history.title: Captions hotfix

changes.text: Captions: fixed "Host script error (ck_sources / ck_ppPrepare / ck_ppPlace)" - the Captions host functions now always load in After Effects and Premiere Pro, and any real error now shows its reason

history.title: New Captions tab (CaptionKit 2.2), offline Whisper, ElevenLabs multi-key

changes.text: Captions tab rebuilt with CaptionKit 2.2 (AE + Premiere Pro): 121 caption styles with live previews, Word / Phrase / Sentence / Smart caption modes, 80+ languages, Hinglish, translation, emoji and swear censor
Captions: right-click any style to customize it - fonts, colours, size, position (drag it in the preview), glow, drop shadow, animation - with your own frame as the preview
Captions: Whisper (offline) engine - free captions on your own computer, no key and nothing uploaded (engine built in on Windows; Mac via Homebrew)
Text to Speech: Google Gemini voices + ElevenLabs with several API keys, credits shown for every key and auto-switch when a key runs out
Settings > API Keys > Captions & Text to Speech: one place for the Gemini key, ElevenLabs keys, Whisper, caption AI model, voice AI and ffmpeg - stays in sync with the Captions tab
Premiere Pro: captions go to a Caption track or a Video track; AE captions are editable text layers
Version label + update checker now show the real version; Map 3D camera layer and 3D Toolkit layer order fixes are included

history.title: 3D Toolkit, Parallax, Putty, 3D Maps

changes.text: Editor Mode > 3D Toolkit (AE): one-click camera rig, 24 camera moves, Target (layer to layer), 16 shakes, Layout (Z / X / Y / grid / circle / random), Depth of Field + auto focus, Depth Fade, Overlap
3D Toolkit > Parallax (AE): give every layer a depth without the picture jumping (scale compensation) + 12 parallax camera moves
Viral > Putty (AE): bend any layer with a cage - drag the points on the preview, 15 shape presets, 12 living presets (jelly, sway, flag, melt ...), keyframe it or drive it with nulls
Map: search any place, 3D tilted maps with heading / orbit, sky + haze, extruded countries, Tour camera, drop pins / flags, car / ship / train travellers
Grid Reveal: 33 new premade presets (incl. Text Reveal)
Every new tool: settings in the right slide drawer + mouse control in the live preview (orbit, dolly, pan, zoom)
Light leaks: your own light leak videos show up by themselves - no more Scan again; the empty footage box is gone

history.title: Text Behind (BETA), TypePlay flicker + 3D

changes.text: Tracker > Text Behind (BETA, AE + Premiere): text behind the people in a video or image - people found every frame, edge detail, settings drawer, all installed fonts
TypePlay: 8 reveal directions in one row under the tabs, preview plays on every preset click, hover = animated thumbnail
TypePlay: Flicker (10) and 3D (14) text presets

history.title: BG Generator styles, Map preview, Premiere popups

changes.text: BG Generator: 14 new looks (dashed grid, zebra marble, watercolor, pinstripes, squiggles, sunburst, crumpled paper, polka, checker, glow curve, plasma, topographic)
Map: mouse wheel zoom + drag in the preview, maps app look, everything goes in as a precomp
TypePlay: fixed preview while presets scroll, reveal direction arrows, 8 bounce presets
Mask Splitter: zoom / pan preview, cut-out with your own masks, different animation per part
Premiere: Separate Audio / Auto Duck / Scene Detect / Vertical each in its own popup, better voice detection in Auto Duck
Premiere Graph tab rebuilt: clean bezier graph, handles never hide
Premiere SFX tab: top buttons visible on narrow panels; light leak files found anywhere in the MotionKit folder
MotionKit AI tab removed; Generate Video removed from Premiere AI Mode

history.title: Map, Quick Tools, Light Leaks, Photoshop

changes.text: Editor Mode > Map (AE): animated world maps - highlight countries, routes between cities, camera fly-ins
Quick Tools: TypePlay text animator + BG Generator
24 real light leak videos in Transitions > Light Leaks
Premiere Project tab: Separate Audio, Auto Duck, Scene Detect, Vertical
Photoshop version of MotionKit
Resizable compact settings drawers; Mask Splitter v2; Generate Video accepts any code

history.title: Grid Reveal studio, Mask Splitter, Client Review links

changes.text: Viral > Grid Reveal studio with visual presets and a settings drawer
Editor Mode > Mask Splitter: every part of an image becomes its own animated layer
Connect > Client Review links: send a watch-only link, comments come back
Split Screen: real pictures in the preview, settings drawer

history.title: MotionKit Connect + theme presets

changes.text: Editor Mode > Connect: phone live preview + remote control, Wireless Import, shortcuts, annotations (local Wi-Fi + remote)
Theme presets: accent + background + buttons in one click

history.title: Mockups as precomps

changes.text: Mockups are added as one precomp, screen footage replaceable, 2D / 3D switch

history.title: Tracker + Graph presets

changes.text: Editor Mode > Tracker (AE + Premiere): track & attach any layer / clip, stabilize, zoomable preview
Graph: presets drawer, multi-key graph; Premiere Smooth Graph

history.title: Grid Focus, Split Screen mouse control, Align shortcuts, FX slots

changes.text: Grid Focus (multiple images), Split Screen mouse control, Align shortcuts, FX slots, Purge

history.title: Path Carousel, 95 transitions, 52 carousel templates

changes.text: Path Carousel (AE + PP): footage / cards / text along a 3-point path, edit with the mouse
95 new transitions in AE + PP (Dissolve, Distort & Grunge, Light & Glow, Blur, Motion)
Premiere 3D Carousel: 52 new templates, exact frame-size preview
Premiere: MOGRT box width / height, Guides presets slide panel
Media Player without black bars; Download settings layout fix

history.title: Smart Adjust / Null / Camera, Shake tool, Emoji + 3D Elements

changes.text: Align: drag bar to resize the anchor grid
Keyframes: Mirror at the playhead
Quick: smart Adjust / Null / Camera / Light (Click = around all, Ctrl = per layer, Shift = cuts / control null)
Quick: Sequence, Fit Comp, one Organize popup, Wiggle & Shake tool
Popups: preview height handle, option groups in one row with a slider
Elements: Shapes, Blobs, Emoji (219) and 3D Elements (261) tabs; overlap fixes
Item & Tag compact comp section; clean FX Search; icon stroke setting

history.title: Premiere polish, Cursor Timeline, new Person & Timeline animations

changes.text: Premiere: every button icon now uses the same thin Material style as After Effects
Align: bigger anchor point grid; the anchor icon style switcher moved to Settings > Theme under Anchor grid style
Premiere Color: palette color boxes fill with Ramp (both colors the same) - no Tint
Preview left / settings right everywhere: drag the divider to resize the live preview, set the spacing in Settings > Look & feel
SFX: one clean top bar - search, folder dropdown, volume, rescan and settings; boxes show only the name
Trim Paths: the live preview shows a square, or the selected shape layer / mask itself
Cursor: new Cursor Timeline - add moves, clicks, drags, hovers and waits, watch the live preview and add it to the comp / sequence
Person: 45 new avatar and team animations
Timeline: 51 new templates
FX Search opens inside the panel without the window title bar; Premiere footer buttons removed

history.title: Big update: common settings, new icons, AI / Search / Person elements

changes.text: Settings: one common Animations switch (Off / Hover / Always) and one Size (Small / Medium / Large) for every tab - lots of separate options removed
License: 1 computer per license
Align tab: Move & Properties shows the selected layer / clip and lets you edit Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity and Anchor live (After Effects + Premiere Pro)
Premiere Color: color boxes fill with Ramp (both colors the same) and gradients use Ramp with both gradient colors - no more Tint
New thin Material Symbols icons on every tab, button and popup - no glow, no drop shadow
Export: settings button next to Export - resolution, frame rate, bitrate, render quality, image size, JPG quality, GIF and audio settings
All popups are smaller, follow the panel size and show the live preview on the left with the settings on the right
Elements: 3 new tabs - Person (58), Search (62) and AI Mode (105 animations: AI chats, prompts, Nano Banana style image edits, voice orbs, agents ...)
Chat tab: 41 new chat and comment styles, shown in one row with a slider
Editor Mode > Guides: platform presets open in a slide panel from the right, toggles in one top row, color next to Opacity
Premiere 3D Carousel: 46 new templates (105 total) and drag clips / footage straight from the Project panel
Premiere SFX: folder dropdown next to search, rescan + settings next to the volume, settings panel with insert position, view, box width / height and duplicates, boxes show only the SFX name
Number Counter live preview in After Effects
Carousel presets in one row with a slider (After Effects)
FX Search window opens once instead of restarting while it loads; faster panel start (3D Carousel thumbnails load when the tab opens)
Premiere anchor box sits inside its card
